answer_1.quote: Recent advancements in Large Language Model (LLM) and LLM-powered agents have shown considerable potential in enhancing human ... capabilities in data science.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are code snippets in Python for data science tasks such as data manipulation, aggregation, visualization, and analysis, produced by data science agents in response to natural language queries.

answer_2.quote: The "Pass Rate", which is the number of problems passed divided by all problems in the benchmark, is the default metric used to assess the quality of an agent.

answer_3.quote: Some others resort to another more powerful LLM to score the output of the agent, which may introduce bias and overlook errors.

answer_4.quote: Human experts step in for revision. Their focus lies in assessing clarity, diversity, and difficulty, and introducing necessary adjustments the LLM may struggle with independently.
